result.title: Quasipolynomial-Time Planning for Decodable POMDPs
result.summary: We study planning for finite-horizon partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) with finite state, action, and observation spaces. Both exact and approximate planning are known to be computationally hard in this setting, so prior work has explored natural assumptions that make planning easier. Recent work [Golowich et al., 2022] gave quasipolynomial-time approximate planning algorithms for observable POMDPs. These are POMDPs whose observation channels satisfy an $\ell_1$-observability condition, but notably, no assumptions are required on the transition dynamics. In a similar vein, for every fixed $ρ>0$, we give quasipolynomial-time approximate planning algorithms for $ρ$-decodable POMDPs. We show that decodability is implied by both $\ell_1$- and $\ell_2$-observability and is strictly weaker than observability. Moreover, we show that the optimal decodability constant can be computed in polynomial time, whereas computing the optimal $\ell_1$-observability constant is NP-hard in the worst case. We also show that the fast filter-forgetting guarantee underlying the approach of [Golowich et al., 2022] does not extend directly from $\ell_1$-observability to constant $\ell_2$-observability. Thus, decodability is an easy-to-check, unifying assumption under which quasipolynomial-time approximate planning for POMDPs is possible.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究有限时域 POMDP 的近似规划，证明对固定 ρ>0 的 ρ-decodable POMDP 存在拟多项式时间算法，并说明可解码性弱于 ℓ1/ℓ2-observability 且其最优常数可多项式时间计算。
AI.relevance_reason: 可解码性刻画隐状态能否从观测序列中恢复，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的「可辨识性」与信息坍缩、信念状态维护提供形式化视角，并关联规划与决策成本；但属纯理论 POMDP 结果，与视觉推理的衔接需核查。
